title: How to Build a Mobile App Without Coding in 2026
summary: You no longer need to learn Swift, Kotlin, or React Native to ship a mobile app. Here's how to build one with AI in under an hour — database, auth, and hosting included.
body_markdown: Not if you build a Progressive Web App (PWA). PWAs install directly from the browser — no App Store submission, no $99/year developer account, no review process. Users visit your URL, tap "Add to Home Screen," and it works like a native app. Blink generates mobile-first responsive apps by default, so your app works this way without any extra configuration.
